item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-26
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects recently. The `statcheck` and `oddpub` projects have both received updates, with `statcheck` undergoing administrative updates and `oddpub` improving its ontogenerator with a code validation update. Meanwhile, `docpluck` has addressed several issues, including resolving "W0l ×-as-3 residuals" and fixing rendering problems, while `coarse` has re-enabled Fable 5 in its model picker. Notably, `regcheck` has made several improvements, including updating its demo page, fixing bugs, and renaming survey routes to avoid ad blocker interference. Additionally, `escicheck` has been synchronized with the latest version of `effectcheck`, highlighting the connections and collaborations between our projects. These updates demonstrate the community's commitment to ongoing development and improvement.

5 commits across 4 active repositories this week.
